Title: Unix onboarding, single account
Request: what to send / change: Base Unix body: platform=Unix, ciName=<FQDN>, ciClassification=DEV, osVersion=RHEL 8, narId=<valid>, targetRole=[], 1 account (root / Application / Local / password) with a non-empty test secret.
Expected response: 200 OK. Body has id (UUID) and status = PUBLISHED.
Expected logs: registration chain (searc:
asset-registration-service: event received (neopam.asset.registration.requested.v1), 'Event processed successfully'.
asset-persistence-service: 'Asset registration persisted successfully' (neopam.asset.registered.v1).
No ERROR or stack trace.
Expected DB (asset_registry): New row in asset_registry: event_type = neopam.asset.registered.v1, created_at close to request time (row count +1).
Expected logs: privilege-fulfilment-serv:
'Technical onboarding completed(UNIX)' and 'Successfully link account' for each account in the request.
No ERROR or stack trace.
